data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: Define schemas for gate files. (a) .reconciler-phase-gate: single-line plain text containing the canonical phase name ('dry-run' | 'bootstrap-strict' | 'bootstrap-throttle' | 'live'). (b) .reconciler-phase-gate.ops: JSON Lines, one entry per line: {operator, timestamp, phase, comment}. check_phase_gate <phase> resolves match by comparing requested phase to .reconciler-phase-gate content OR scanning .reconciler-phase-gate.ops for any entry whose phase matches AND whose timestamp is newer than the previous entry. Schema co-located with audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh as a comment block at top of file.
